root: ^"Finally. Someone actually leaving. You have no idea how boring it is standing here all day."
^"You're a knight, isn't guarding the city important?
^"Why don’t you just request a different post?"
^"If you’re so bored, why don’t you spar with me?"

c-0: ^"Sure, sure. Super important. Until you realize nothing ever happens here. It’s just me, the gate, and the occasional lost traveler asking dumb questions."
c-1: ^"I did. The Captain told me to ‘build patience.’ I think he just wants me to suffer."
c-2: ^"Tempting. But if I actually beat you, the Captain will have me scrubbing armor for ‘undermining his rules.’ No thanks."
